page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head "VITA" at the top, page number "116" at the top left. Catchword "Rab-" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: bus odiosæ sunt. Huic extremo vitæ Mo-rini actui interfuêre sodalium suorum non pauci, & cum aliis adfuit Harlæus, frater Harlæi Sancii Congregationis eti-am Oratorii Presbyter, homo mortalium omnium facetissimus, qui Morinum intuitus anhelum & vix dimidiata verba pronunciantem, ita sodales suos affatus est, mehercle Morinus noster Samaritice loquitur, quibus auditis omnes in risum effusi sunt; & hic fuit extremus Morini vitæ actus; tunc temporis sub prælo erat nova editio exercitationum illius Bibli-carum, nondumque ad partem alteram, quam primæ adjungebat, pervenerat, cùm inter evolvendum Rabbinorum Li-bros obiit, & quia tunc nemo inter gre-gales suos repertus est, qui excudendo re-liqvo operi manum admovere posset, quòd omnes ob Rabbinologiam ab hoc onere suscipiendo deterriti fuissent, Pa-ter Fronto ex ordine illorum qui vulgo appellantur Canonici Regulares Sancti Augustini, Cancellarius Universitatis Parisiensis illud aggressus est, & ut erat

page.notes: The first word "bus" is a fragment; the first letter is partly hidden in the gutter and may be a larger initial, so the reading "bus" is less certain. "Samaritice" has a grave accent over the final e in print, shown here without it; the italic line may be slightly unclear. The 1 in the page number looks like a dotted i ("116"). Ligatures and spellings such as "qvi", "qvia", "qvod" are rendered with u as "qui", "quia", "quod" per the convention, but the printed forms use v in "qvi", "qvia", "qvod" and "reliqvo". The "Rab-" at the foot is a catchword, not part of the text.
